challenges.name: parcel-status-state-machine
challenges.title: Track a parcel's status with an enum
challenges.description: Parcel statuses used to be strings, and the cash report missed every parcel marked "Delivered" instead of "delivered". Now a Status enum carries the data of each status (the driver, the collected cash, the return reason). Write three methods of Parcel: apply(&mut self, event: Event) -> bool, which moves the parcel to its next status when the event is allowed (out, deliver with the exact cash due, fail with three attempts before a return, recall) and returns false otherwise; label(&self) -> String; and cod_collected(&self) -> u32. The test runner reads parcel registrations and events, prints every rejected event, each parcel's label and the cash collected.

tests.name: Example from the task: the wrong cash amount is rejected
tests.input:
new SH-1001 250000
SH-1001 out Minh
SH-1001 deliver 200000
SH-1001 deliver 250000
tests.expected:
SH-1001: rejected deliver (out with Minh)
SH-1001: delivered, COD 250000 VND
COD collected: 250000 VND

tests.name: Three failed attempts return the parcel; a fourth trip is rejected
tests.input:
new SH-2001 0
SH-2001 out Lan
SH-2001 fail nobody home
SH-2001 out Lan
SH-2001 fail nobody home
SH-2001 out Lan
SH-2001 fail wrong address
SH-2001 out Lan
tests.expected:
SH-2001: rejected out (returned: wrong address)
SH-2001: returned: wrong address
COD collected: 0 VND

tests.name: Recall from the depot, and events that are not allowed
tests.input:
new SH-3001 90000
SH-3001 deliver 90000
SH-3001 recall
SH-3001 out Hoa
new SH-3002 120000
SH-3002 out Hoa
SH-3002 recall
tests.expected:
SH-3001: rejected deliver (in depot)
SH-3001: rejected out (returned: recalled by sender)
SH-3002: rejected recall (out with Hoa)
SH-3001: returned: recalled by sender
SH-3002: out with Hoa
COD collected: 0 VND

tests.name: Several parcels: a prepaid delivery, cash totals and a parcel still out
tests.input:
new SH-4001 0
new SH-4002 315000
new SH-4003 48000
SH-4001 out Tuan
SH-4002 out Tuan
SH-4003 out Tuan
SH-4001 deliver 0
SH-4002 deliver 315000
tests.expected:
SH-4001: delivered, COD 0 VND
SH-4002: delivered, COD 315000 VND
SH-4003: out with Tuan
COD collected: 315000 VND

tests.name: Two failed attempts, then a delivery; a delivered parcel never changes
tests.input:
new SH-5001 60000
SH-5001 out Minh
SH-5001 fail gate locked
SH-5001 out Minh
SH-5001 fail gate locked
SH-5001 out Minh
SH-5001 deliver 60000
SH-5001 fail too late
SH-5001 recall
SH-5001 out Minh
tests.expected:
SH-5001: rejected fail (delivered, COD 60000 VND)
SH-5001: rejected recall (delivered, COD 60000 VND)
SH-5001: rejected out (delivered, COD 60000 VND)
SH-5001: delivered, COD 60000 VND
COD collected: 60000 VND
